# fhir-validator-lite

Lightweight FHIR R4 JSON validator. No external dependencies, zero-allocation-friendly where possible, strict JSON parsing.

- [README.md](README.md): Usage and API.
- [SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and limits.
- [TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md): Test suite structure.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Component breakdown.
